opportunities.title: Main Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK; individuals must have formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration; organisations must be UK‑based; projects led by schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, or for PhD fees are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports research addressing priority questions from the Foundation’s Strategic Review, with up to £500,000 per grant and two application deadlines per year.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals and organisations, especially from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications are encouraged; projects must focus on UK racial diversity issues.
opportunities.summary: Funds research on racial diversity in the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, with grants ranging from £15,000 to £500,000.
